name: Motorized Bicycle
description: A moped: two tandem wheels, or one in front and two behind, that may be pedaled, with a helper motor of no more than 50 cc that produces no more than 1 brake horsepower (750 W) and can't push it past 20 mph on a level surface. An electric bicycle is excluded.

restrictions.rule: Two tandem wheels, or one in front and two behind, and pedals
A helper motor of no more than 50 cc piston displacement producing no more than 1 brake horsepower (750 W); the definition doesn't separately address electric motors
Can't propel it faster than 20 mph on a level surface
An electric bicycle (operable pedals, under 750 watts, class speeds) is excluded
Riders 14 and 15 need a probationary motorized bicycle license, which takes a knowledge test and a riding demonstration; riders 16 and older need a driver's license or a motorized bicycle license
Riders under 18 must wear a protective helmet with the chin strap fastened, and the moped must have a rear-view mirror
Registered with the BMV, with a $10 license tax
Ridden within three feet of the right edge of the roadway when practicable, obeying the traffic rules for vehicles
